buildStarBodies

Builds every catalog body into the scene graph: pivots for orbiting bodies (rotation.y = phase + t·speed), fixed groups for pos bodies, satellites and shells, then registers the node, anchor and pickable in the state maps.

mountGalacticRider

Galactic co-rotation — the solar system and its stellar neighborhood are not stationary: the real Galaxy carries the Sun around the galactic centre, so everything heliocentric must ride the Milky Way's rotating disc as one structure. This mounts a rider group on the disc's spin target at the Sun's true local ring position, then re-parents every unparented node whose whole extent fits inside SF_SCALE.CO_ROTATE_R — the Sun's pivot (which carries the planets, their satellites, and later the deep-field star cloud), orbiting bodies pivoted at the origin, the named-star neighborhood, and the local hierarchy shells. Because the carved heliocentric bubble lives in the same rotating frame, it stays locked on the Sun forever — the earlier static-outer-disc workaround is no longer needed. The rider counter-tilts its own X so children keep their ecliptic orientation (the solar system's plane is not the galactic plane).

  • @param s Engine state (nodes map must be fully populated).
  • @param THREE The three.js module.
